command:
set -u; echo FRED_CUTOVER_PREFLIGHT=1; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo USER=$(id -un); systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager; echo SELF_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo '--- guard dropins ---'; systemctl cat entityos-vm.service --no-pager | sed -n '1,220p'; echo '--- volatile semantic dbs ---'; sudo find /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -name '*.db' -o -name '*.sqlite' -o -name '*.sqlite3' \) -printf '%p	%s bytes
' 2>/dev/null | sort; echo '--- durable entityos data ---'; sudo find /var/lib/entityos/data -maxdepth 4 -type f -printf '%p	%s bytes
' 2>/dev/null | sort | head -200; echo '--- candidate manifests/rescue ---'; find . -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*manifest*' -o -iname '*rescue*' -o -iname '*cutover*' -o -iname '*migration*' \) -print | sort | head -200
